name: interface-craft
description: General interface visual craft: hierarchy, contrast, anti-pattern detection on UI files.

interface.shortDescription: Mechanical UI craft checks plus critique methods.
interface.longDescription: Detects mechanical interface anti-patterns on UI files after edits, and supplies first-party craft-floor and critique methods. It does not write posters, decks, Remotion, or logos, and it does not replace web-frontend syntax or lockfile gates.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface against the craft floor.
Check this page for hierarchy and contrast anti-patterns.
